values.summary: Coordinate the twenty-package C-SDLC v3 construction graph from contract freeze through writer-fenced cutover, enforcing Decision 11 before transaction work and keeping V3-R01 explicitly deferred. Fail closed on missing terminal, producer, ancestry, dependency, cleanup, or path-ownership proof.

steps.action: Freeze the exact V3-01 through V3-16 plus V3-R01 ledger, verify six-card and design readiness, preserve all eleven architecture decisions, and record V3-R01 as deferred rather than runnable.

Run V3-01 then V3-02; obtain V3-D11 before V3-08; release foundation, repository, state, lifecycle, adapter, command, PVF, review, GitHub, finish, and cutover packages only when every declared predecessor is terminal.

Recompute each child terminal revision, card/index digest, dependency ancestry, and issue-specific producer proof; stop on parity loss, unsupported platform behavior, stale review, failed recovery, or any attempt to start deferred V3-R01.
Verify V3-16 writer-fenced cutover and rollback proof, retain V3-R01 as deferred until rollback expiry, prove no umbrella-owned product edits, and publish independently reviewed lane synthesis.

invariants: The umbrella may coordinate and synthesize but cannot modify child-owned product paths.
Children retain exclusive implementation and review ownership.
No unsupported completion, legal, production, or release claim
No mutation outside exact owned paths
risks: Umbrella scope could absorb child work
A stale status could start a child early
stop_conditions: A dependency or serialization gate is ambiguous
Coordination would require a product-path edit
